slice: RPP-5jv MLINE LAYER carrier geometry guard
scope: Connects the selected bounded AC1027 LAYER source/live proof to AC1021+ MLINESTYLE geometry-edit export preflight and repeats the proof during adapter finalization. This is an opt-in, narrow refusal gate; it does not complete dependency closure, authenticate emitted sections, enable consumed geometry, or promote support claims.

contract.selection: The source/live guard runs only for a modern MLINESTYLE geometry transaction when whole-source or legacy-identity observation is selected. The proof itself requires its full admitted source profile and fails closed otherwise. Unobserved ordinary adapter routes retain their existing behavior.
contract.preflight: The selected AC1027 ASCII/binary profile binds the accepted source and live LAYER model. A caller-added LAYER appData group-340 carrier referring to the edited style is rejected before publication.
contract.finalization: After writer callbacks, adapter finalization reruns the LAYER source/live proof when preflight selected it. A test consumer injects the hidden carrier immediately before base finalization; the export is refused before replacing the destination.
contract.failureAndRetry: Preflight refusal preserves the destination sentinel, edited style offset and caller appData. The finalization-time refusal preserves the destination and offset; the test hook removes its injected appData after the base finalizer returns. Disabling the hook and retrying on the same adapter succeeds; readback retains the selected style offset and has no LAYER appData.
contract.compatibility: The selected proof is private to dx_iface and is used only on selected modern geometry edits. Existing non-opt-in routes were exercised by the MLINESTYLE transaction selector. Existing LibreCAD-facing callback/API shape is unchanged.
contract.limits: The proof covers only the admitted selected AC1027 LAYER profile and bounded logical work (512 MiB configured ceiling; not an RSS or CPU guarantee). It does not authenticate all LAYER scopes/forms, other carriers, all mutations by hostile subclasses, or actual staged section contents. Generated CLASSES, HEADER/HANDSEED backpatch, TABLES, BLOCKS, ENTITIES and OBJECTS still need output-bound authentication. The selected layer gate does not enable consumed offsets or other currently refused operations.

controls.readbackChecks: The selected MLINESTYLE retains its edited offset and the test LAYER appData is absent.
controls.sourceConstruction: The AC1027 DXF text and hidden LAYER appData are authored in the test; binary input is encoded locally. The finalization mutation is injected by a test-only consumer subclass. Temporary files are cleaned up. No DWG/DXF fixture file was added to Git.

asanBuild.command: cmake --build build/rpp5fa-evidence.4xKADX/asan-build --target libdxfrw_mline_source_dependency_tests libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests libdxfrw_whole_source_tests libdxfrw_legacy_blockref_relation_tests libdxfrw_no_raw_sections_tests -j4

validation.diffCheck: PASS (git diff --check and git diff --cached --check; JSON parsed with python3 -m json.tool)

next: Extend source/live dependency protection to the next exact admitted carrier and authenticate actual staged output, especially generated CLASSES and the post-inspection HANDSEED backpatch. Keep consumed geometry refused until all affected references and emitted geometry are independently proved.
